remarks_1999: Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert to Stoddard, June 1961, as 'Blue Sky, 1941." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1946 or 1941? Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1941. Dated 1941 on basis of Stieglitz—O'Keeffe correspondence. See cat. nos. 1027, 1063, 1064. Titled *Blue Sky* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: backing inscription, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, Whitney Archive in 1969.
